description: A Jupyter Notebook script for testing and evaluating multiple Large Language Model (LLM) providers using LiteLLM, including quality testing, load testing, and data visualization.

methods.name: load_dotenv
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file.

methods.name: load_test_model
methods.description: Performs load testing by sending multiple simultaneous requests to specified models with a given prompt.

methods.name: testing_batch_completion
methods.description: Performs batch testing of multiple models with different prompts and collects responses.

methods.name: invokeFunction
methods.description: Invokes a Colab kernel function, used for interactive data table conversion and chart suggestions.

methods.name: renderOutput
methods.description: Renders output data in Colab for interactive display.

methods.name: convertToInteractive
methods.description: Converts static data tables into interactive ones within Colab.

methods.name: suggestCharts
methods.description: Suggests visualizations based on data in Colab.
